entry.name: jit.gl.slab
entry.description: Generate, process and combine images efficiently using fragment shaders. Develop custom texture effects for processing on the graphics card.

attributes.name: activeinput
attributes.digest: Current input number
attributes.description: The current input used for texture and matrix messages (default = 0). Useful when calling input messages from Java or JavaScript.

attributes.name: adapt
attributes.digest: Enable adapt to input
attributes.description: Enable adapt to input (default = 1). When enabled the texture output dimensions will match the input dimensions.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: autowatch
attributes.digest: Enable watching for changes in the source file
attributes.description: Enable watching for changes in the source file (default = 1). When file watching is on, the file is recompiled automatically when it is modified. This allows you to use an external editor for your file.

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bypass
attributes.digest: Bypass slab processing
attributes.description: Bypass slab processing flag (default = 0). When enabled the input is passed through to the output without processing.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: colormode
attributes.digest: Texture color mode

attributes.name: dim
attributes.digest: Texture output dimensions
attributes.description: The texture output dimensions whenis disabled (default = 256 256)

attributes.name: dimscale
attributes.digest: Output dimension scaling factor
attributes.description: The output dimension scaling factor of the output (default = 1 1). Useful for upsampling or downsampling texture output.output.dim = input.dim*dimscale

attributes.name: embed
attributes.digest: Save file with patcher
attributes.description: When enabled, the shader file is saved with its patcher. If the object is loaded in a patch with noargument, embed is enabled by default. If a file argument is provided, embed will be disabled unless explicitly enabled by the user.

attributes.name: file
attributes.digest: Shader description file (JXS)
attributes.description: The shader description file (JXS) to use (default = none)

attributes.name: filter
attributes.digest: Texture filter mode
attributes.description: Set texture filter mode on internal texture objects (default = linear). This controls the magnification filter used when a texture is rendered at a size larger than its native resolution. The filter determines how a texture's pixels, or texels, are interpolated to fill the larger screen space.

choices.digest: Uses the color of the single nearest pixel
Calculates a weighted average of the four closest texels

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Slab geometry rectangle
attributes.description: Slab geometry rectangle (default = 0 0 1 1). The four values represent normalized coordinates for the left, bottom, right and top sides of the geometry rectangle. To flip the image horizontally useor to flip vertically use.

attributes.name: rectangle
attributes.digest: Enable texture rectangle mode (default = 1)
attributes.description: Enable texture rectangle mode on internal texture objects(default = 1). When enabled the internal GL texture is treated as a rectangular texture, and must be referenced using sampler2DRect and sampled using texture2DRect when sampled from a GLSL shader. When disabled the texture dimensions are upsampled to the nearest power of two value, and must be referenced and sampled using sampler2D and texture2D. Certain texture attributes and GLSL effects require rectangle mode disabled.

attributes.name: thru
attributes.digest: Enable thru mode
attributes.description: Enable thru mode (default = 1). When the flag is set, texture output is sent whenever input is received.

attributes.name: type
attributes.digest: Output texture data type
attributes.description: The output texture data type (default = auto). When type isthe type is set by the input texture or matrix type.

messages.digest: Sends an input texture a message
messages.description: Sends a message to an input texture. If the first arg is an int, it specifies the texture index to send the message, otherwise all input textures receive the message.
